$ git commit -m "v0.7.0: 主线重构 — Tonybot Action Simulator

- 项目收敛为以动作模拟器为核心的 Tonybot Action Simulator
- 新主入口: simulator/index.html (i18n zh-CN/en-US)
- 新数据层: data/official-actions/ (204 个动作组 JSON)
- 工具集中: tools/python/ (rob_*.py + export-official-actions)
- 知识归档: knowledge/docs/ + knowledge/wondercode/
- 历史归档: legacy/choreography/ + legacy/motion-studio/
- 更新日志: 更新日志/ → changelog/
- 旧目录 python-toolkit/wondercode-toolkit 保留不动
- 未引入 COM/支撑面/平衡分/React/AI 编舞"
[exit 0]
